top_signals.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls nearly 15% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market
top_signals.summary: Dick's Sporting Goods reported second fiscal quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac says the future of supercars is old-school combustion engines
top_signals.summary: Bugatti CEO Mate Rimac told CNBC he thinks high-end sports cars will continue to have combustion engines "for a very long time" even with the rise of EVs.

top_signals.title: Over 41,000 in Japan sent to the hospital for heatstroke in July
top_signals.summary: The 41,174 figure was the third highest for July since 2008, when the statistics were first compiled, following the 54,220 people logged in 2018 and 43,195 in 2024.
